Lady Durinbold's Attendant is a wood elven ranger who accompanies her mistress to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.
“
Lady Alia says 'jump', and I jump. That's the way of things.
„
— Lady Durinbold's Attendant

Involvement

Lady Durinbold's Attendant can be found at the mess hall, at the first floor of the Wyrm's Rock Fortress. She came with her mistress,  Lady Alia Durinbold, and while waiting for her lady to descend from Audience Hall, spends time chatting with retinue members of other patriars.

First time spoken to, she is discussing the Steel Watch with  Lord Shattershield's Attendant and  Lord Amber's Bodyguard, and asks the party's opinion on these automatons. She scolds Lord Amber's Bodyguard for his doubt in the Steel Watchers' abilities, saying that the constructs, unlike him, do the work better and without complaints.

If talked with afterwards, she expresses utter obedience and loyalty to her mistress' demands. She repeats her lady's opinion that the Steel Watch and the Flaming Fist together are able to stop any army, even that of the Cult of the Absolute.

If confronting Gortash, Lady Durinbold's Attendant can be found along with all other invited guests and their retinue slaughtered in the Audience hall.
